snippet.title: Pup & Mole: Gold Rush - Mining Adventure Roguelite - Gameplay Teaser
snippet.description:
Join Pup & Mole on a cozy mining adventure across 7 historical areas. Hop into your minecart, build rail tracks, and dig deeper for hidden artifacts. Upgrade your gear, unlock new tools, and complete your collection while earning money by selling gold and rare treasures.

Wishlist now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4550700/Pup__Mole_Gold_Rush/
